name: debug_runner
description: Run command/script/test and analyze failures: 14 error types, 4-language stack traces, suggested actions. script mode auto-picks runtime (js/py/go/rs/sh). Deterministic, zero LLM.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

script.description: Script path relative to workspace_dir to run + auto-analyze (js/mjs/py/go/rs/sh by extension)

test.description: Test command to run in workspace_dir (e.g. "npm test", "pytest")
